description:
Cast Spiteful Hexmage by paying {B}.
When Spiteful Hexmage enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Cursed Role token attached to it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Spiteful Hexmage, adding {B}.
Spiteful Hexmage is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard due to Necromancer's Magemark.
Repeat.
